seo.title: Trade on the XRPL DEX
seo.description: Trade XRP and issued tokens on {{explorerName}} with a live order book and simple limit orders.

title: Trade on the DEX
description: Choose a pair, compare live prices, and place a limit order with your preferred wallet.

form.selectPair: Select both assets to start trading.
form.accountGlobalFreeze: This account has Global Freeze enabled and cannot receive or trade issued tokens.
form.accountGlobalFreezePermanent: This account has permanent Global Freeze enabled and cannot receive or trade issued tokens. Use another account for this swap.
form.insufficientLiquidity: Not enough liquidity in the direct order book.
form.ammInsufficientLiquidity: The direct AMM pool cannot fill this amount. Try a smaller amount.
form.buyBalanceInsufficient: Not enough {{asset}} balance or market liquidity to buy this amount. Enter a smaller amount.
form.swapLiquidityInsufficient: There is not enough market liquidity to swap this amount. Enter a smaller amount.
form.noRoute: No liquidity route is currently available for this pair. Try again later or choose another pair.
form.quoteUnavailable: The XRPL execution quote is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
form.nativeBalanceInsufficient: Not enough available {{asset}} to complete this swap and cover the network fee or reserve.
form.swapFailed: XRPL could not execute this swap. The selected token may be restricted or unavailable for trading.
form.swapProtection: Estimated result · protected against more than 2% slippage.
form.marketEstimate: Indicative market estimate; the executable XRPL quote may differ.
form.simulatedQuote: Simulated across direct and XRP routes using order books and AMMs · 2% slippage protection.
form.walletHint: You will review and sign the transaction in your wallet. Bithomp never has access to your keys.
